[[Hell on Earth - Part 1]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Hello again! Remember the good old time when all the major fighting took place at Polikhim? People were buying tons of gear from me back then. There was a kit, the most popular among PMCs. I was wondering how it performs in the field nowadays. Check it out for me and tell me how it is, yea?}} ==Requirements== * This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game. * Must be level 27 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while using Colt M4A1 or M16, [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)|6B43 body armor]], and [[FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet|Kiver-M helmet]] on [[Factory]] ==Rewards== * +76,000 [[EXP]] * [[Prapor]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 256,000 Roubles ** 268,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 294,400 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle]] (variant 2k18 NY) * 2× [[M1A 7.62x51 20-round magazine]] * 3× [[7.62x51mm M62 Tracer ammo pack (20 pcs)]] {{quote|Thanks for your help, soldier! Nowadays, there's battles all over the city, and everyone's got their own different equipment. It's an arms race, I'll tell you that!}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Notes |- ![[File:Peacekeeping Mission M4A1 icon.png|link=Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle]] |[[Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle]] |1 |Used by the player to eliminate PMC operatives. |- ![[File:Kiver-M Helmet icon.png|link=FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet]] |[[FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet]] |1 |Worn by the player while eliminating PMC operatives. |- ![[File:FORT armor icon.png|link=6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]] |[[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]] |1 |Worn by the player while eliminating PMC operatives. |} ==Guide== In this quest you have to use a either the [[M4A1]], the [[M16A1]] or the [[M16A2]] to kill 10 PMCs on [[Factory]] while also wearing both the [[FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet]] and the [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]]. You can modify the weapons and bring additional items to what is required. ==Trivia== This quest is a reference to the beginnings of the game. Back when the only helmet was the [[FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet]] and the only available armors were the [[PACA Soft Armor]] and the [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]]. So running a Kiver-M helmet + 6B43 armor combo on [[Factory]] was the meta. {{Navbox quests}} [[Category:Quests]] [[fr:Les Bons Moments - Partie 1]] [[ru:Как в старые добрые. Часть 1]]
